gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.name: Name
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_interna: Internal form name/id (used to build the form key). Lowercase, no spaces.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_the_nam: The name shown in-game for this form. Blank = a tidied version of the internal name. Supports & colour codes.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_shown_u: Shown under the form in the skills GUI. Blank = none. Supports & colour codes.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_level_o: Level of this race's form skill required before this form can be unlocked.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_tp_cost: TP cost to unlock this form at its skill level, just like DMZ's default forms. Saved into the race's formSkillsCosts so the form is buyable in the skills menu. -1 = leave unset/locked. Needs an Unlock Skill Lv of 1+ (stack/race-agnostic forms can't use this).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_min_lev: Minimum character level to transform into this form. A player below it cannot use the form and is dropped out of it if already in it. Blank or 0 = no minimum. This gates using the form, not buying it. Works for every form, including stack forms (kaioken, ultimate).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_align_u: DMZ alignment (0-100) needed to BUY this form. Set a minimum and/or maximum; leave a field blank for no bound on that side. Alignment reads above 60 as good, 41 to 60 as neutral, 40 or below as evil (majin forces 0). A player outside this window cannot unlock the form. Both blank = no unlock restriction.

DMZ alignment (0-100) needed to transform into and stay in this form. Set a minimum and/or maximum; leave a field blank for no bound on that side. A player whose alignment leaves this window cannot transform and is dropped out of the form if already in it. Works for every form, including stack forms. Both blank = no use restriction.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_unlock_: Custom text shown for this form's unlock requirement (e.g. 'Unlocked by quest X'). Leave empty to show the default cost / Priceless label. Supports & colour codes.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_key_com: Key combo/input used to transform into this form (leave blank for none).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_model_t: Model this form uses. Pick a DMZ race (human/saiyan/namekian/frostdemon/bioandroid/majin) to borrow that race's model AND its eyes/nose/mouth face set, a pack model, or blank to keep the base model.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_animati: Animation played when transforming into this form.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_another: Another form that must be unlocked/active before this one is available.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_keep_th: Keep the base model's head bones (hair, etc.) instead of the form's.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_primary: Primary body colour while in this form (blank = unchanged).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_seconda: Secondary body colour (markings/accents). For Saiyans this also colours the tail while in this form (blank = default brown).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_an_extr: An extra body overlay layer to render for this form.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_tint_co: Tint colour for the extra form layer.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_hair_st: Hair style used in this form (e.g. ssj).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_advance: Advanced: force a specific hair code instead of the type (blank = use Hair Type).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_tint_co: Full-body tint blended over the skin/hair/body colours while in this form (the same mechanic Kaioken uses). Needs Tint Intensity above 0 to show.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_tint_in: Strength of the tint. 0 disables it; Kaioken x2 uses 0.1, x3 uses 0.2. Higher values push the whole model further toward the tint colour.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_colour_: Colour of the first eye in this form.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_aura_sh: Aura shown while in this form.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_which_a: Which aura render layer/slot to use.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_show_el: Show electric/lightning effects around the body.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_model_s: Model scale in this form: three comma-separated numbers (1 = base size).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_aura_wi: Multiplies the aura's width in this form (1 = default, 0.1-5.0).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_aura_he: Multiplies the aura's height in this form (1 = default, 0.1-5.0).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_multipl: Multiplies Strength (melee damage) while in this form.
Multiplies how fast attacks drain stamina in this form.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_ki_drai: Ki drained PER SECOND to hold this form. DMZ scales this up (by power release + combat baseline + mastery), so keep it SMALL - DMZ's own forms use ~0.03-0.5. Even 1.0 is steep; values like 20 empty your ki the instant you transform.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_stamina: Stamina drained per second while in this form.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_health_: Health drained per second while in this form.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_mastery: Mastery gained per hit you land while in this form.
Mastery gained per hit you take while in this form.
Mastery gained every 5 seconds just for staying in this form.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_drain_u: Drain/upkeep multiplier at full mastery (usually < 1 = cheaper when mastered).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_extra_s: Extra stat multiplier granted at full mastery.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_mastery: Mastery of the requisite form needed before this one unlocks (0 = none).
Mastery at which this form becomes stackable.
Mastery at which transforming becomes instant (skips charge-up).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_always_: On: the form is selectable/transformable from 0 mastery, so it shows up in-game right away (DMZ allowFreeTransformOnMastery = 0). Off: set a mastery threshold below.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_free_tf: Mastery of this form the player must reach before it becomes selectable/transformable in-game.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_whether: Whether this form can be stacked on top of a stack form (e.g. Kaioken).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_extra_d: Extra drain multiplier applied while stacked.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_forms_t: Forms that cannot be active at the same time as this one.
Forms that share mastery gains with this one.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_fractio: Fraction of mastery shared with the forms above.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_draw_a_: Draw a glowing outline shader around the character in this form.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_seconda: Secondary colour of the outline (mixes with primary over time).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_how_thi: How thick the outline is drawn (1 = default).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_scale_o: Scale of the noise pattern in the outline (higher = finer).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_how_fas: How fast the primary and secondary outline colours blend.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.chance_to: §7Chance to fully avoid an incoming hit (0-100%).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_chance_: % chance to dodge VANILLA/non-DMZ hits (mobs, weapons, environment). DMZ's own punch combat is a strike skill - use Melee Skill Dodge for that, not this.
% chance to dodge DMZ melee (strike) attacks - this is DMZ's normal fist/punch combat.
% chance to dodge DMZ energy/ki attacks (Kamehameha, ki blasts, etc.).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_of_a_no: % of a non-dodged hit's damage reduced while in this form (0 = off).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.each_hit_: §7Each hit taken buffs stats by a % of the damage.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_temp_st: Temp Strength added per hit = this % of the damage taken. Cleared when the form ends.
Temp Strike Power added per hit = this % of the damage taken.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_temp_re: Temp Resistance added per hit = this % of the damage taken.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_temp_vi: Temp Vitality added per hit = this % of the damage taken.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_temp_ki: Temp Ki Power added per hit = this % of the damage taken.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_temp_en: Temp Energy added per hit = this % of the damage taken.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.form_edit.t_cap_on_: Cap on the buff, as a % boost of the stat. 100 = the stat can at most double; 0 = no buff (so leave this at 100+ or the stat gains do nothing).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.race_edit.t_interna: Internal id and config folder name (lowercase). Also the base for its lang keys.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.race_edit.t_model_t: Model this race uses. Pick a DMZ race (human/saiyan/namekian/frostdemon/bioandroid/majin) to borrow its model AND face set (the Body tab's eyes/nose/mouth then list that race's options), a pack model, or blank for the default player model.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.race_edit.t_default: Default aura shown for this race.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.race_edit.t_aura_wi: Multiplies this race's base aura width (1 = default, 0.1-5.0). A form's aura-size override, if any, takes priority.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.race_edit.t_aura_he: Multiplies this race's base aura height (1 = default, 0.1-5.0). A form's aura-size override, if any, takes priority.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.race_edit.t_comma_s: Comma-separated model bones treated as the head (e.g. hair) for hiding/attaching.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.race_edit.t_whether: Whether characters of this race choose a gender at creation.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.race_edit.t_use_the: Use the player's Minecraft skin as the base texture.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.race_edit.t_render_: Render body layers (form overlays, tattoos, etc.) on top of the base model.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.race_edit.t_give_th: Give this race a Saiyan-style tail. Off: the race is tailless. NOTE: DMZ shows a tail for custom races that use a non-tailless model, so with the tail OFF and no Custom Model set the editor points the race at the tailless 'human' base model (set your own Custom Model to override).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.race_edit.t_the_rac: The race's shown name (e.g. at character creation). Blank = a tidied form of the id. Supports & colour codes.
The race description shown in the selection/stats screen. Supports & colour codes.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.race_edit.t_default: Default body-shape index for new characters of this race.
Default model scale, three comma-separated numbers (1 = vanilla size).
Default colour of the first eye.
Default colour of the second eye (heterochromia if different).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.race_edit.t_one_row: One row per form skill (e.g. superforms, godforms). The costs list length is that skill's max level; each number is the TP cost to buy the next level. -1 locks a level. A form unlocks at its Unlock Skill Lv = position in this list.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.race_edit.no_form_s: §8(no form skills yet; Add Group to gate custom forms)
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.race_edit.t_make_a_: Make a brand-new class (opens its stats editor) or add an existing class this race supports.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.race_edit.t_the_rac: The racial passive this race grants. Pick one, Edit its name/description, or make a new one.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.raceclassstats.t_th: This class's id within the race (lowercase). Rename freely; its stats are kept.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.classpassive.t_sduS: Multiplier on melee damage this class deals. 0.25 = +25%.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.classpassive.t_sduA: Added armour penetration. 0.15 = ignore 15% of defence.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.classpassive.t_sduH: Share of stamina regen granted as EXTRA hp regen. 0.5 = half again.
Multiplier on healing this class receives. 0.25 = +25%.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.classpassive.t_sduK: REDUCTION in ki attack cooldowns. 0.2 = 20% shorter.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.classpassive.t_sduS: Multiplier on a ki attack's buff or debuff duration. 0.25 = +25%.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.classpassive.t_sduB: Health fraction below which everything above is scaled. 0.33 = below a third. 0 = always on.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.classpassive.t_sduL: What every effect is multiplied by below that threshold. 2 = double.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.raceclassstats.t_sh: Shown on the character screen. Leave blank to use a tidied version of the id.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.raceclassstats.t_th: The blurb under the class on the character screen. Leave blank for none.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.raceclassstats.t_st: Starting Strength for this class (melee damage).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.raceclassstats.t_ho: How much each Strength point is worth for this class (growth multiplier).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.raceclassstats.t_gr: Growth multiplier per Skill Power point.
Growth multiplier per Power point (ki damage).
Growth multiplier per Energy point (max ki).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.raceclassstats.t_he: Health regenerated every 5 seconds, before scaling.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.raceclassstats.t_ex: Extra HP/5s per point of Vitality.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.raceclassstats.t_ki: Ki (energy) regenerated every 5 seconds, before scaling.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.raceclassstats.t_ex: Extra ki/5s per point of Energy.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.raceclassstats.t_st: Stamina regenerated every 5 seconds, before scaling.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.raceclassstats.t_ex: Extra stamina/5s per point of Stamina.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.raceclassstats.t_mu: Multiplier on Training Point cost to raise stats (lower = cheaper).
Multiplier on Training Points earned (higher = faster progression).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.raceclassstats.t_wh: Whether this class's passive effect is active.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.racialability.t_int: Internal id (lowercase) and the base for its lang keys + behaviour lookup.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.racialability.t_the: The racial ability's shown name. Supports & colour codes.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.racialability.t_wha: What this racial ability does (shown in the race/stats screen). Supports & colour codes.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.racialability.t_for: For the ON_LOW_HP trigger: effects apply while health is below this % of max (Zenkai-style).
For ON_LOW_HP / ON_HIT / ON_KILL / ACTIVE: how long the effects last after triggering.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.racialability.t_coo: Cooldown before this racial can trigger again. Applies to every trigger except Always-On.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.racialability.buff_: §7Buff each stat by a % of its base while active.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.racialability.regen: §7Regen = per second while active. Restore = on trigger.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.racialability.t_per: Percent of max health restored per second while active.
Percent of max ki (energy) restored per second while active.
Percent of max stamina restored per second while active.
Percent of max health restored instantly when the racial triggers.
Percent of max ki restored instantly when the racial triggers.
Percent of max stamina restored instantly when the racial triggers.
Percent of incoming damage reduced while the racial is active.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.racialability.t_van: Vanilla/mod effects applied while active. Amplifier defaults to level I; edit racial_skills.json (id:amplifier) for higher levels.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.quest_edit.title: Title
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.quest_edit.t_the_qu: The quest's title shown to players.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.quest_edit.t_numeri: Numeric quest id, unique within the saga; also orders quests.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.quest_edit.t_time_l: Time limit in SECONDS to finish this quest once accepted (0 = untimed). When it runs out the quest is reset and the player is told. Enforced by the addon (DMZ has no built-in quest timer).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.quest_edit.t_party_: Party: scale objective amounts to party size.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.quest_edit.t_secret: Secret: hide this quest in the tree until its parent is completed.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.quest_edit.t_parall: Parallel: objectives can be completed in any order at once.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.quest_edit.t_branch: Branch: put this quest on a SIDE PATH off the main line, so it moves to its own row/position like DMZ's side questlines. The main line is ALWAYS a straight row - turn this ON (plus set 'Branch after') to make a real branch. Saved as a side quest.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.quest_edit.t_the_pa:
The parent quest that must be finished before THIS one unlocks.
• MAIN LINE (Branch OFF): parent = the previous quest → a straight chain (1→2→3). DMZ always draws the main line as one straight row.
• SIDE BRANCH (turn Branch ON above): this quest moves to its own path hanging off the chosen parent - set 2a, 2b, 2c to Branch ON and point them at quest 2 (or chain 2a→2b→2c) to get a separate branch like the base DMZ questlines.
(root) = a starting quest, no parent.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.quest_edit.t_object: Objectives: what the player must do to complete this quest.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.quest_edit.t_reward: Rewards: what the player receives when the quest is completed.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.quest_edit.t_extra_: Extra start conditions only: minimum LEVEL, a DIMENSION/BIOME, or ALIGNMENT. This is NOT for quest order - to gate on finishing another quest use 'Branch after' above.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.quest_edit.t_prereq: Prerequisites: HIDE the quest entirely until these are met (e.g. a RACE). Unlike Requirements, the quest is not shown at all. The 'Branch after' link is managed separately and not listed here.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.sidequest_edit.t_un: Unique side-quest id (lowercase). Also names its file under dragonminez/sidequests.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.sidequest_edit.t_ca: Category used to group side quests in the quest book (e.g. training, combat).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.sidequest_edit.t_th: The quest's title shown to players.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.sidequest_edit.t_np: NPC that offers this quest (blank = none). DMZ QuestNPC id; searchable.
NPC the quest is turned in to (blank = same as giver / none). Searchable.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.sidequest_edit.t_pa: Party: scale objective amounts to party size.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.sidequest_edit.t_se: Secret: hide this quest until its prerequisites are met.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.sidequest_edit.t_pa: Parallel: objectives can be completed in any order at once.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.sidequest_edit.t_qu: Quest type. SIDEQUEST is a one-shot quest; DAILY and EVENT are repeatable (always enabled). For a repeatable quest, add a TIME start requirement to set how long before it becomes available again.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.sidequest_edit.t_ob: Objectives: what the player must do to complete this quest.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.sidequest_edit.t_re: Rewards: what the player receives when the quest is completed.
Requirements: conditions the player must meet before the quest starts (e.g. LEVEL, a prior QUEST).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.sidequest_edit.t_pr: Prerequisites: HIDE the quest entirely until these are met (e.g. a RACE). Unlike Requirements, the quest is not shown at all.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.sidequest_edit.t_wr: Write this side quest to the world save. Reload the world for DMZ to load it.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.sidequest_edit.t_re: Return to the side-quest list (keeps edits in memory; use Save to persist).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.formgroup_edit.t_in: Internal group/category id (lowercase). Names its config file.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.formgroup_edit.name: Name
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.formgroup_edit.t_th: The category name shown in-game for this form group. Blank = a tidied id. Supports & colour codes.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.formgroup_edit.t_fo: Form skill this group unlocks with. Each maps to a real DMZ form skill: superforms, godforms (Ultra Instinct/Ego / divine forms), legendaryforms, androidforms, kaioken. The player needs that skill unlocked to transform. Re-join the world after saving so DMZ reloads the forms.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.formgroup_edit.t_wh: Which races get this form group. Blank/(stack) = a race-agnostic stack-forms group.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.formgroup_edit.chec: §7(check every race that should get this group)
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.formgroup_edit.t_ad: Add a new form to this group and open it for editing.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.formgroup_edit.t_pa: Paste the copied form into this group.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.formgroup_edit.t_wr: Write this group to DMZ's config (each selected race) and reload.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.formgroup_edit.t_re: Return to the form list (use Save Group to persist).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.formgroup_edit.move: Move up: swaps ladder position and unlock level with the form above
Move down: swaps ladder position and unlock level with the form below
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.reward_edit.t_rewar: Reward on completion: TPS training points, an ITEM, a SKILL level, or a COMMAND to run. The fields below change per type.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.reward_edit.t_grant: Grants a ki/strike technique (kamehameha, galick_gun, …) on claim, via /rg npc givetechnique. Unlike a SKILL reward this actually gives the usable attack.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.reward_edit.t_unloc: Unlocks the ability to BUY this form once the quest is complete. The form still costs its normal TP and is NOT granted - completing the quest just lifts the purchase lock.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.npc.objective_edit.t_wh: What the player must do: KILL an entity, collect an ITEM, TALK_TO an NPC, reach a DIMENSION/BIOME/STRUCTURE, or level a SKILL. The fields below change per type.

race.dragonminez.shadow_dragon.desc: A race born of the wish-granting dragons, cloaked in living shadow. They channel the ancient power of the eternal dragons, trading a mortal's frailty for scaled resilience and radiant ki. When they cast off their restraint, their true draconic form surges forth in a torrent of azure energy.
race.dragonminez.shadow_dragon_2star.des: The two-star shadow dragon, born of a wish that poisoned the air. Its corruption clings like smog, and those who wear its form breathe ruin into every fight.
race.dragonminez.shadow_dragon_3star.des: The three-star shadow dragon of bitter cold. Its ki freezes the marrow, and its chosen vessel turns the battlefield to a field of ice.
race.dragonminez.shadow_dragon_4star.des: The four-star shadow dragon of living flame. Honor burns as fiercely as its fire, and its form grants the searing heat of a small sun.
race.dragonminez.shadow_dragon_5star.des: The five-star shadow dragon of stored fury. It drinks in every current around it and lashes out with the wrath of a storm made flesh.
race.dragonminez.shadow_dragon_6star.des: The six-star shadow dragon of tide and tempest. Beautiful and merciless, its form commands the fury of wind and water alike.
race.dragonminez.shadow_dragon_7star.des: The seven-star shadow dragon of the devouring earth. It consumes all it touches to grow ever stronger, and its vessel inherits that endless hunger.
race.dragonminez.half_saiyan.desc: Born of one Saiyan parent and one of another world, a half-Saiyan blends earthbound heart with warrior blood. They grow fast, adapt faster, and surprise foes who underestimate mixed lineage.

gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.ki_edit.title: Edit Ki Blast
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.ki_edit.type_t: Which DragonMineZ ki attack this blast fires. Searchable list of every saga ki skill.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.ki_edit.interv: Lowest ticks between uses (20 ticks = 1s). Each spawned mob rolls a value in [Min, Max]. Note: DMZ scales the actual fire rate, so the real interval is roughly double this.
Highest ticks between uses. Set equal to Min for a fixed interval. Note: DMZ scales the actual fire rate, so the real interval is roughly double this.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.ki_edit.size_t: Projectile / effect scale multiplier. 1 is the normal size.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.ki_edit.colour: Main colour of the ki blast (an 0xRRGGBB hex). Border/outline are derived automatically.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.title: Advanced NPC Spawner
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.entity: Which entity this spawner spawns. Searchable list of every registered entity type (DMZ, sdu, vanilla). Picking one fills the Stats tab with that NPC's DMZ default Health / Melee / Ki / AI Tier. Every ragnarok NPC character is in this list too, as its own row (rgnpc#name): type a character's name to find it.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.displa: Custom name shown above the spawned entity's head. Leave blank for the entity's default name. Supports & colour codes.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.rg_mod: Which ragnarok NPC character it looks like, when the entity above is dmz_ragnarok:rgnpc. All of them (the ninjin cast included) share that one entity type, so this is where the actual character is chosen. Leave it blank for any other entity. Not the same as Model ID, which is a CustomNPCs model.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.model_: For sdu NPCs only: which custom model to render. e.g. dmz_ragnarok:default. Ignored by other entities.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.saved_: New system: a saved Custom NPC clone as tab$name (e.g. 0$Raditz). When set, spawns dmz_ragnarok:dmz_fighter configured from it; the Ki/Behavior/Model options below are then ignored.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.health: Max health (DMZ default when an entity is picked). Overrides the entity's max health attribute.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.melee_: Melee/attack damage (DMZ default when an entity is picked). Overrides the attack damage attribute.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.ki_dam: Ki-blast damage (DMZ default when an entity is picked). Sets a fixed amount; the Ki tab exposes a Min/Max range and a per-move loadout for finer control. 0 = melee only / DMZ default.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.ai_tie: Combat smarts: Simple / Tactical / Advanced (teleport, dodge and block frequency; sdu NPCs). DMZ's per-NPC default is Simple.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.scale_: Render/hitbox scale multiplier. 1 = normal size. Applies to sdu NPCs.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.speed_: Overrides the entity's movement speed attribute.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.use_de: Turn OFF to disable DMZ's built-in transformations for this NPC. A custom chain below overrides them regardless.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.transf: A custom chain overrides DMZ's built-in transformations. Turn the toggle off to disable them.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.ki_min: Lowest ki-blast damage. Each spawned sdu NPC rolls a value in [Min, Max]. 0 = leave DMZ's default.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.ki_max: Highest ki-blast damage per spawn. Set both equal for a fixed amount.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.ki_bla: Pick specific ki blasts, each with its own type, interval range, size and colour. When set, this explicit loadout replaces the Moveset's ki attacks. Empty = use the Moveset below.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.movese: Which DMZ fighter's ki attacks this NPC uses (sdu NPCs). AI Tier lives on the Stats tab.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.ki_att: Enable ki attacks from the moveset. Off = melee only.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.behavi: How the entity behaves toward players (sdu NPCs).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.enable: Master on/off switch. A disabled spawner spawns nothing until re-enabled.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.spawn_: How many entities this spawner keeps alive at once.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.cooldo: Ticks between spawn attempts (20 ticks = 1 second).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.wander: How far a spawned entity may wander from the spawner. 0 keeps it in place.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.time_o: Only spawn during this part of the day. Morning = around sunrise, Dusk = around sunset.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.weathe: Only spawn during this weather. Rain includes thunderstorms.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.redsto: Gate spawning on a redstone signal to the spawner block. Wire it to levers, daylight sensors, anything.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.boss_e: Mix a boss into the spawns. Requires the server key: without it the boss never spawns. One boss alive at a time.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.boss_c: Chance per spawn wave (0-100) to roll the boss, checked only while no boss from this spawner is alive.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.boss_e: Which entity the boss is. Ignored when a Saved NPC is set below. Picking one fills the boss Health / Melee / Ki fields with that NPC's DMZ defaults. Every ragnarok NPC character is in this list too, as its own row (rgnpc#name): type a character's name to find it.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.boss_r: Which ragnarok NPC character it looks like, when the entity above is dmz_ragnarok:rgnpc. All of them (the ninjin cast included) share that one entity type, so this is where the actual character is chosen. Leave it blank for any other entity. Not the same as Model ID, which is a CustomNPCs model.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.boss_n: Name shown above the boss. Leave blank for the entity's default name. Supports & colour codes.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.boss_k: Lowest boss ki-blast damage (0 = melee only). Each spawn rolls a value in [Min, Max]. Moveset/AI Tier/Behavior are inherited from the Ki tab.
Highest boss ki-blast damage per spawn. Set both equal for a fixed amount.
Pick specific ki blasts for the boss, each with its own type, interval range, size and colour. Empty = inherit ki behaviour from the Ki tab moveset.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.boss_s: Render/hitbox scale multiplier for the boss (sdu NPCs).
Optional: a saved Custom NPC clone as tab$name. When set, the boss spawns as dmz_ragnarok:dmz_fighter fully configured from it (model, moves, animations).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.boss_u: Turn OFF to disable DMZ's built-in transformations for the boss. A custom chain below overrides them regardless.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.tp_min: Lowest DMZ Training Points granted to the player who kills a spawned entity. Requires DragonMineZ.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.tp_max: Highest DMZ Training Points per kill. A random amount in [Min, Max] is granted. Set both equal for a fixed amount.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.balanc: Lowest Shurui's Utilities balance granted to the player who kills a spawned entity. Requires Shurui's Utilities.
Highest balance per kill. A random amount in [Min, Max] is granted. Set both equal for a fixed amount.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.kill_c: Console commands run when a player kills a spawned entity. Separate several with ; and use %%player%% for the killer's name, e.g. give %%player%% minecraft:diamond 3; xp add %%player%% 10 levels
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.vanill: Whether the entity's own loot-table drops still appear on death. OFF (default) = only the custom drops below drop.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.add_he: Adds the item you are holding as a drop, copying its full NBT data (enchantments, custom names, modded tags). Rows with NBT show a purple diamond.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.drop_r: Item id to drop, e.g. minecraft:diamond. Min/Max = count range, % = roll chance (0-100).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.spawner.disgui: Block this spawner renders as (e.g. minecraft:stone) so it blends in. Leave blank to show the spawner model.
message.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.config_sav: Dungeon config could not be saved. Nothing was changed; see the server log.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.config.title: Dungeon Config
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.config.time_li: How long a player may stay in the dungeon before being returned, in seconds. 0 disables the time limit.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.config.cooldow: Cooldown, in seconds, after a player is timed out before they may re-enter. 0 disables the cooldown.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.config.pvp_tip: Allow players to damage each other inside the dungeon dimension.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.config.ki_bloc: Allow DMZ ki attacks to break blocks inside the dungeon dimension.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.config.block_e: Allow ordinary players to break and place blocks by hand inside the dungeon dimensions. Creative mode is never restricted, so staff can still build arenas.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.config.floor_g: Warp to this floor. Builds it on first visit.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.config.floor_r: §cRe-stamps fresh terrain on the next visit and discards any detail hand-built into this floor. Click again to confirm.
Remove this floor from the list.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.floor_edit.the: The material family the whole floor surface is built from, and the themed dimension it generates in. Applies when the floor is first generated (or regenerated).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.floor_edit.lay: Which room-layout algorithm this floor uses. Default inherits the server's configured layout. Applies when the floor is first generated (or regenerated).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.floor_edit.siz: Side length, in blocks, of the floor's terrain. A bigger floor gives the layout more room to spread. Applies when the floor is first generated (or regenerated).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.floor_edit.dep: How far, in blocks, the solid body extends below the floor surface. Applies when the floor is first generated (or regenerated).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.floor_edit.typ: Normal floors are the room layout. A Boss floor is one large standalone arena, themed to this floor, holding its guardian; clearing it opens the way to the floors after it.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.floor_edit.bos: Whether this boss floor spawns its guardian. Off leaves the arena empty and the way past it open.
Open the boss editor: entity, stats, ki, transform chain, and the reward and drop pools that pay out by damage percentage on death.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.loot.refresh_h: Real hours before a crate re-rolls its tier and every player's contents. 0 means it never refreshes: a player loots each crate once and it stays theirs.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.loot.chest_cha: Share of chests (0-100) promoted to crates. 100 is the old behaviour, every one of them; a floor with a lot of chests can turn this down so the rest stay plain chests. The exact chests chosen are fixed per position, so everyone sees the same ones.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.loot.barrel_ch: Share of barrels (0-100) promoted to crates. A promoted barrel becomes a crate chest, the same as a promoted chest; the rest stay plain barrels. The exact barrels chosen are fixed per position, so everyone sees the same ones.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.loot.weight_ti: How likely a crate rolls this tier, relative to the other three. Higher means more common. Zero means this tier never appears.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.loot.zeni_min_: Lowest zeni paid when this tier is opened (once per refresh window). Leave the max at 0 to fall back to the theme default payout.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.loot.zeni_max_: Highest zeni paid when this tier is opened. 0 falls back to the theme default payout for this tier.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.loot.edit_drop: Edit this tier's reward pool. One item is drawn per open, weighted by each entry's percent. An empty pool falls back to the theme default (currently a testing nether star).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.npcs.enabled_t: Whether generation drops a disguised spawner into the floor block under each spawner-rune position on this floor. A spawner picks one of the presets below at random by weight.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.npcs.edit_tip: Edit this preset's spawner: entity, stats, the NPC-defense curve, ki, behaviour, transforms and the kill rewards.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.npcs.weight_ti: Selection weight. Higher means this preset is chosen more often when a spawner rolls which enemy to place. Minimum 1.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.dungeons.npcs.duplicate: Duplicate this preset. A full copy is inserted directly below and shares no data with the original.

gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.list.tip: Every configured raid. Edit opens its settings, Signups opens sign-ups, Delete removes it. §a[ready]§7 = an arena is set; §c[no arena]§7 = set one first.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.browser.title: Raid Bosses
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.browser.subtitle: Choose a raid to join
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.reward_edit.title: Edit Reward
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.reward_edit.type_t: What this reward does. The fields below change to match the selected type. Command/message support %%player%% %%damage%% %%damage_percent%% %%rank%% %%boss%% %%total_damage%%.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.title: Edit Raid
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.subtitle: Raid: %s
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.display_name_: The raid's display name, used in announcements, the sign-up GUI, the NPC name, and in commands (/rg raid join <name>). Supports & colour codes.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.host_entity_t: Which entity is used as the sign-up NPC. Searchable list of every entity from every mod. Right-clicking it opens sign-up. Every ragnarok NPC character is in this list too, as its own row (rgnpc#name): type a character's name to find it.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.host_model_ti: Which ragnarok NPC character it looks like, when the entity above is dmz_ragnarok:rgnpc. All of them (the ninjin cast included) share that one entity type, so this is where the actual character is chosen. Leave it on (default) for any other entity.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.npc_name_tip: The name shown above the sign-up NPC's head.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.boss_entity_t: Which entity is spawned as the raid boss. Any living entity works (DMZ mobs, warden, wither, etc.). Every ragnarok NPC character is in this list too, as its own row (rgnpc#name): type a character's name to find it.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.boss_model_ti: Which ragnarok NPC character it looks like, when the entity above is dmz_ragnarok:rgnpc. All of them (the ninjin cast included) share that one entity type, so this is where the actual character is chosen. Leave it on (default) for any other entity.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.boss_name_tip: Display name shown above the boss and on its boss bar. Supports & colour codes.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.raid_type_tip: Standard = one scaled boss. Parallel Quest = a wave of assorted enemies scored by damage AND kills (MVP). Boss Rush = a sequence of bosses spawned one after another.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.category_tip: The dropdown group this raid appears under in the raid-NPC browser (e.g. 'Saiyan Sagas'). Supports & colour codes.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.show_in_npc_t: If OFF, this raid is hidden from the NPC browser (useful for Soul-only or template raids).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.event_only_ti: If ON, this raid runs only while a timed event lists it, and is otherwise hidden and never scheduled.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.mvp_weight_ti: MVP score = total damage + this weight x kills. Raise it to reward kills more than raw damage.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.parallel_note: §7Everyone who dealt damage or scored a kill is ranked; the MVP gets the Top reward.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.rush_note: §7Bosses spawn in order; each stage has its own pre-spawn delay. Rewards are given once the final boss falls.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.standard_note: §7Configure the single boss under the General, Scaling and Boss tabs.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.bounds_player: Where players are placed when they enter this raid. Unlike the arena this keeps the height you selected. Leave unset to scatter players across the arena as before.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.arena_note1: §7Players are teleported inside this region; the boss spawns at its centre.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.arena_note2: §7PvP inside the arena follows the 'PvP in Arena' rule (Rules tab).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.base_health_t: The boss's max health for a single participant.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.health_per_pl: Extra max health added per additional participant. Total = base + perPlayer x (participants - 1).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.max_health_ca: Hard cap on the scaled max health. 0 means no cap.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.scale_damage_: If ON, the boss also hits harder with more participants.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.damage_per_pl: Extra attack damage added per additional participant (only used when 'Scale Attack Damage' is ON).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.max_damage_pc: The most a single hit may take off this boss, as a percent of its max health. 2.5 means the boss always takes at least 40 landed hits, however powerful the hitter is, so nobody can one tap the raid. Set 0 for no ceiling. This limits the HIT, not the player: their stats and their damage everywhere else are untouched, and the damage leaderboard counts what the boss actually took.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.boss_note1: §7DragonMineZ saga bosses only. 0 / (none) keeps the entity's own value.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.boss_note2: §7Battle power is derived at spawn: round(melee + ki power).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.boss_finale_t: PARALLEL QUEST only: after the last enemy wave is cleared, spawn this boss as the finale. The raid bar switches from the NPC count to the boss's HP.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.melee_damage_: The boss's melee attack-damage attribute. 0 keeps the entity default.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.defense_tip: Damage-resistance stat (DMZ defense scale, higher = tankier) applied via the suite NPC-defense curve. 0 = no mitigation.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.ki_damage_tip: Damage dealt by the boss's ki attacks. 0 keeps the entity default.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.move_speed_ti: The boss's movement-speed attribute. 0 keeps the entity default.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.boss_scale_ti: Visual / hitbox size multiplier. 0 keeps the entity default.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.ai_tier_tip: Combat AI sophistication (DragonMineZ AI tier). Simple < Tactical < Advanced. (none) keeps the entity default.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.ki_moves_note: §7Empty = the boss keeps its own default ki moves.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.use_default_t: When ON the boss transforms via DragonMineZ's own logic. A custom transformation chain (below) always overrides this.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.transformatio: §7Custom form chain fired as the boss's HP drops (shared SDU editor).
§7Install Shurui's DMZ Utilities (SDU) to edit custom boss transformations.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.signup_minute: How long sign-ups stay open before an auto-scheduled raid begins.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.reminder_tip: Repeat the sign-up announcement (chat + clickable Join button + on-screen title + sound) every N seconds while sign-ups are open. 0 = announce only once.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.min_participa: If fewer than this many players sign up, the raid is cancelled instead of starting.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.max_participa: Cap on the number of participants. 0 means no limit.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.require_chara: If ON, a player must have created a DragonMineZ character before they can sign up.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.heal_on_start: Fully restore every participant's health, energy and stamina when the fight begins.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.pvp_arena_tip: Allow players to damage each other inside the arena. Normally OFF so nobody hits allies by accident.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.prevent_reent: If ON, any player who is not an active participant of the running raid is bounced out of the arena, preventing re-entry (eliminated fighters stay locked out too).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.vanilla_drops: Whether raid enemies still drop their own loot-table items on death. OFF (default) = no incidental drops; rewards come from the reward table.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.use_titles_ti: Also show big on-screen titles (not just chat) for major announcements.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.countdown_tip: Countdown after participants are teleported in, before the boss spawns.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.time_limit_ti: If the boss isn't killed within this time, it despawns and nobody is rewarded. 0 = no limit.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.auto_schedule: If ON, sign-ups open automatically at the time below. If OFF, run manually with /rg raid open <name>.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.repeat_every_: If > 0, sign-ups also auto-open every N minutes (anchored at midnight) on cadence-matching days. 0 = off.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.daily_times_t: A comma-separated list of 24h HH:MM times, e.g. 09:00, 14:30, 20:00. Overrides the single Hour/Minute below. Malformed entries are dropped.
Times list overrides the single time below; Repeat Every fires every N minutes. Day-of-week/month still gate which days.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.hour_tip: Time of day (server local, 24h) that sign-ups auto-open. 0 = midnight.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.minute_tip: Minute of the hour for the auto-open time.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.day_of_week_t: Weekly cadence: 1=Monday .. 7=Sunday. 0 ignores this and (unless Day of Month is set) runs DAILY.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.day_of_month_: Monthly cadence: day of the month to run. 0 ignores it and falls back to the weekly or daily schedule.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.announce_soun: Sound played to everyone on major announcements. Searchable list of every sound; choose (none) to disable.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.music_tip: Sound looped for fighters inside this encounter, on the music channel. Searchable list of every sound; choose (none) for no music. Loops until the boss dies or the fight ends.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.spawn_on_bloc: When ON, the boss spawns seated on the chosen block inside the arena instead of the arena centre, so you can place that block to pick his exact spot. Nearest such block to the arena centre is used. If none is found, he spawns at the centre and a warning names the encounter.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.spawn_block_t: Block the boss is seated on when the option above is ON. Default minecraft:obsidian.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.msg_signup_op: Chat message when sign-ups open. Placeholders: {name} {id} {npc} {boss}. Use & colour codes.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.msg_starting_: Message when the raid starts. Placeholders: {name} {count} {boss}.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.msg_boss_spaw: Announced when the boss spawns. Placeholders: {name} {boss} {health}.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.msg_victory_t: Announced when the boss is defeated. Placeholders: {name} {boss} {top} {top_percent}.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.msg_timeout_t: Announced when the fight times out. Placeholders: {name} {boss}.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.rewards_note1: §7Top = #1 (MVP in Parallel Quests); Runner-up = ranks #2-4; Participant = everyone who dealt damage or scored a kill.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.rewards_note2: §7Tokens: item: skill: form: tp: command: message:. Placeholders %%player%% %%rank%% %%damage_percent%% %%kills%%.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.rewards_note3: §7Prefix any reward with §fchance:<pct>:§7 for a random custom drop.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.edit.bounds_tip: Two ways to set the %s bounds: make a WorldEdit selection and press "Set via WE", OR type the two corner coordinates (in your current dimension) and press "Set manually". No WorldEdit needed for the manual option.

gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.enemy_edit.title: Edit Enemy
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.enemy_edit.entity_: Which entity to spawn. Searchable list of every entity from every mod. Every ragnarok NPC character is in this list too, as its own row (rgnpc#name): type a character's name to find it.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.enemy_edit.rg_mode: Which ragnarok NPC character these enemies look like, when the entity above is dmz_ragnarok:rgnpc. All of them (the ninjin cast included) share that one entity type, so this is where the actual character is chosen. Leave it on (none) for any other entity.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.enemy_edit.amount_: How many copies of this entity spawn.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.enemy_edit.wave_ti: Which sequential wave this enemy belongs to. Wave 1 spawns first; wave 2 once wave 1 is cleared, and so on, then the optional boss finale (Boss tab).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.enemy_edit.health_: Max health per enemy. 0 keeps the entity's own default health.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.enemy_edit.melee_t: Melee attack damage per enemy. 0 falls back to the raid's melee, then the entity default. Battle power is derived: round(melee + ki power).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.enemy_edit.ki_tip: Ki blast damage per enemy (DMZ saga entities). 0 falls back to the raid's ki damage, then the entity default.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.enemy_edit.defense: Damage resistance per enemy (DMZ defense scale, higher = tankier). 0 falls back to the raid's defense, then no mitigation.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.enemy_edit.scale_t: DragonMineZ saga entities only: size multiplier. 0 keeps the entity default.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.stage_list.title: Boss Rush Stages
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.stage_edit.title: Edit Boss Stage
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.stage_edit.entity_: Which entity this stage spawns. Searchable list of every entity from every mod. Every ragnarok NPC character is in this list too, as its own row (rgnpc#name): type a character's name to find it.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.stage_edit.rg_mode: Which ragnarok NPC character this stage's boss looks like, when the entity above is dmz_ragnarok:rgnpc. All of them (the ninjin cast included) share that one entity type, so this is where the actual character is chosen. Set per stage, so a rush can run a different character every time. Leave it on (none) for any other entity.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.stage_edit.boss_na: Display name over this boss and on its boss bar. Supports & colour codes.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.stage_edit.health_: Max health for this boss. 0 uses the raid's participant-scaled base health.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.stage_edit.melee_t: Melee attack damage for this boss. 0 falls back to the raid's melee, then the entity default. Battle power is derived: round(melee + ki power).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.stage_edit.ki_tip: Ki blast damage for this boss (DMZ saga bosses). 0 falls back to the raid's ki damage, then the entity default.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.stage_edit.defense: Damage resistance (DMZ defense scale, higher = tankier). 0 falls back to the raid's defense, then no mitigation.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.stage_edit.scale_t: DragonMineZ saga bosses only: size multiplier. 0 keeps the entity default.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.stage_edit.delay_t: Seconds to wait after the previous boss dies before this one spawns.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.ki_list.title: Boss Ki Moves
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.ki_edit.title: Edit Ki Move
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.ki_edit.move_tip: Which ki attack the boss fires. Searchable list of every DragonMineZ saga ki skill.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.ki_edit.cooldown_t: Ticks between uses of this move (20 ticks = 1 second). Minimum 1.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.ki_edit.size_tip: Projectile / effect scale multiplier. 1.0 is the normal size.

gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.character.tourname: Builds your fighter for tournament events only. It is not a new character slot: your character is put back as soon as you finish.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.reward_edit: What this reward does. The fields below change to match the selected type.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.title: Tournament
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.displa: The tournament's display name, used in announcements, the sign-up GUI, the NPC name, and in commands (/rg tourney join <name>). Supports & colour codes.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.format: Competitive format. 1v1 / 2v2 / 3v3 run a single-elimination bracket; FFA (Tournament of Power) is one simultaneous free-for-all where the last fighter standing wins. Team rewards go to every member of the winning team.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.group_: Category used to organise this tournament under a collapsible dropdown in the sign-up NPC browser. NPCs can be filtered to one group with /rg tourney npc setgroup. Leave blank for 'Ungrouped'. Supports & colour codes.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.host_e: Which entity is used as the sign-up NPC. Searchable list of every entity from every mod (DMZ, sdu, vanilla). Right-clicking it opens sign-up. Every ragnarok NPC character is in this list too, as its own row (rgnpc#name): type a character's name to find it.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.host_m: Which ragnarok NPC character it looks like, when the entity above is dmz_ragnarok:rgnpc. All of them (the ninjin cast included) share that one entity type, so this is where the actual character is chosen. Leave it on (default) for any other entity.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.npc_na: The name shown above the sign-up NPC's head.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.bounds: Two ways to set the %s bounds: make a WorldEdit selection and press "Set via WE", OR type the two corner coordinates (in your current dimension) and press "Set manually". No WorldEdit needed for the manual option. The region is treated as a full-height column, so only the X/Z footprint matters - a thin floor-level selection is enough and height is ignored.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.auto_s: If ON, sign-ups open automatically at the time below. If OFF, run manually with /rg tourney open <name>.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.hour_t: Time of day (server local, 24h) that sign-ups auto-open. 0 = midnight.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.minute: Minute of the hour for the auto-open time.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.day_of: Weekly cadence: 1=Monday .. 7=Sunday. 0 ignores this and (unless Day of Month is set) runs DAILY.
Monthly cadence: day of the month to run. 0 ignores it and falls back to the weekly or daily schedule.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.signup: How long sign-ups stay open before an auto-scheduled tournament begins.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.min_pa: If fewer than this many fighters sign up, the tournament is cancelled instead of starting.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.max_pa: Cap on the number of contestants. 0 means no limit.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.requir: If ON, a player must have created a DragonMineZ character before they can sign up.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.tourna: If ON, contestants fight with a dedicated tournament character (fixed training points, no growth). If OFF, they fight with their real character and it is never touched.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.items_: If OFF, contestants can't use items during a match, and their inventory + Curios (except armor) are stored away on entering and returned when they leave.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.heal_a: Fully restore both fighters' health, energy and stamina before and after every match.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.force_: Force DragonMineZ's non-lethal 'friendly fist' ON for contestants inside the arena.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.ring_o: If ON, stepping outside the arena's X/Z footprint knocks a fighter out. The arena is treated as full-height, so flying or being launched upward never counts as a ring-out. If OFF, only knockdowns/health decide bouts.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.floor_: If ON, a fighter whose Y falls below the value below is eliminated at once, in the air or not, so anyone knocked into a pit is out the moment they pass the line. Fully independent of ring-out: run either, both, or neither. A Tournament of Power style rule.
The Y below which floor-out eliminates a fighter. Negatives are fine (worlds reach -64). Only used while floor-out is ON.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.exclud: Comma-separated title ids barred from entering this tournament. Anyone holding one of these titles is refused; everyone else, including the champion, enters freely. Blank bars nobody. Titles carry across the shard network, so a holder on another shard is barred here too. Checked only when a fighter signs up, never mid-match.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.flight: If OFF, every fighter's flight is switched off for the whole bout and switched off again if they turn it back on. A grounded format, whatever anyone has unlocked.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.ground: If ON, the sky is the arena: once a fighter has taken off, touching the ground knocks them out. Nobody is eliminated before their first take-off, so the bell never wipes the field. Ignored while flight is off.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.random: Team formats (2v2/3v3) only: after pre-made teams are honored, randomly pair leftover solo sign-ups to fill remaining team slots. If OFF, only complete pre-made teams compete.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.pvp_wa: Allow players to damage each other in the fighter waiting area. Normally OFF.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.pvp_st: Allow players to damage each other in the spectator stands. Normally OFF.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.use_ti: Also show big on-screen titles (not just chat) for major announcements.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.countd: Countdown length after both fighters are teleported in, before the match begins.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.time_l: If a match runs longer than this, the fighter with more remaining health wins. 0 = no limit.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.remind: While sign-ups are open, re-show the 'Sign-ups Open' title and a clickable join prompt every this-many seconds (e.g. 30 or 60). 0 = announce only once. Filling the roster (Max Participants) starts the tournament early.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.announ: Sound played to everyone on major announcements. Searchable list of every sound; choose (none) to disable.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.msg_si: Chat message when sign-ups open. Placeholders: {name} {id} {npc}. Use & colour codes.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.msg_st: Message when the tournament starts. Placeholders: {name} {count}.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.msg_ma: Announced when a match ends. Placeholders: {name} {winner} {loser}.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.edit.msg_ch: Announced when the tournament is won. Placeholders: {name} {champion}.
command.dmz_ragnarok.tournaments.player_: This command must be run by a player.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.spar.enabled_tip: Master switch for the whole sparring feature.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.spar.allow_guild_t: Let two members of the same guild spar.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.spar.allow_party_t: Let two members of the same DragonMineZ party spar.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.spar.require_base_: Guild spars may only start inside the shared guild's claimed land. Party spars never need a base.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.spar.max_sep_tip: The spar ends as a draw if the fighters drift further apart than this, or change dimension.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.spar.invite_expire: How long a pending spar invite stays open.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.spar.cooldown_tip: Wait time before a player may start another spar. Per player. Default 600 (10 minutes).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.spar.idle_timeout_: No blow landed by either fighter for this long ends the spar as a draw.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.spar.max_duration_: Hard length cap; reaching it ends the spar as a draw.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.spar.tp_per_bar_ti: Reward points earned per full bar of health of damage you deal. The main how-hard-you-fought term.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.spar.tp_per_minute: Reward points earned per minute the spar lasts.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.spar.tp_transfer_t: Percent of the loser's earned training points that goes to the winner instead. The loser keeps the rest and never loses more than they earned. 0 turns the transfer off.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.spar.per_spar_cap_: Cap on the health-bar and duration reward points a single spar can earn.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.spar.closeness_exp: Higher values punish power mismatches harder. Payout scales with (weaker BP / stronger BP) to this power.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.spar.min_closeness: If the weaker fighter's battle power is below this fraction of the stronger's, the spar pays zero.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.spar.scale_progres: Convert reward points to TP with DragonMineZ's own progression curve, so the reward tracks growth like a minigame.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.spar.reward_coeff_: Progression curve coefficient. Kept equal to DragonMineZ's training default so a spar point equals a minigame level.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.spar.reward_exp_ti: Progression curve exponent. Kept equal to DragonMineZ's training default.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.spar.flat_tp_tip: TP per reward point when Scale by progression is off.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.spar.block_healing: Block healing items (senzu beans, golden apples) during a spar.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.spar.block_food_ti: Block every edible item during a spar, not just healing items.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.spar.extra_ids_tip: Comma-separated item ids blocked during a spar, on top of Shurui's beans. Example: dragonminez:senzu_bean, minecraft:golden_apple.

gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.list.tip: A rift is a kind of tear: where it opens, how often, and which raid is on the other side.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.edit.title: Edit Rift
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.edit.display_name_: Operator name for this rift, and the fallback label on the tear. Supports & colour codes.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.edit.tear_label_ti: Drawn above the tear so players can see what it leads to. Blank uses the name.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.edit.enabled_tip: A disabled rift keeps its settings but never opens a tear.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.edit.event_only_ti: If ON, this rift opens tears only while a timed event lists it, and its tears close when the event ends.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.edit.look_tip: The tear's appearance. Default is the normal swirl; Halloween is an orange and purple jack-o'-lantern portal with ghost particles.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.edit.raid_tip: The raid fought on the other side. The boss, stages, allies and rewards are all configured on the raid itself.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.edit.theme_tip: Which dungeon dimension the arena is cut into, and what its floor is made of.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.edit.min_minutes_t: Shortest wait between tears of this rift. The actual wait is rolled between min and max.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.edit.max_minutes_t: Longest wait between tears. Below the minimum, it is treated as the minimum.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.edit.lifetime_tip: How long an unclaimed tear stays in the world before it closes on its own.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.edit.regions_tip: Where tears may open. Select none to allow every region, including ones added later.

gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.edit.msg_victory_t: Broadcast when the fighter wins. {player} and {name} are substituted.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.edit.msg_failed_ti: Broadcast when the fighter is lost, logs out, or the run is closed. {player} and {name} are substituted.

gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.ally_edit.entity_t: What this ally is. Ragnarok characters each appear as their own row.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.ally_edit.name: Name
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.ally_edit.name_tip: Shown over the ally's head. Blank uses the entity's own name.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.ally_edit.amount_t: How many of this ally spawn.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.ally_edit.health_t: 0 keeps the entity's own max health.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.ally_edit.melee_ti: 0 falls back to the raid's melee damage, then the entity default.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.raid.ally_edit.ki_tip: 0 falls back to the raid's ki power, then the entity default.

gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.encounter.title: Tear Encounter
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.encounter.boss_ent: What waits on the other side. Ragnarok characters each appear as their own row.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.encounter.boss_nam: Shown over the boss and in the fight's own messages.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.encounter.health_t: The boss's health. A tear is one fighter, so there is no per-player scaling to set.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.encounter.melee_ti: 0 keeps the entity's own attack damage.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.encounter.ki_tip: 0 keeps the entity's own ki damage.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.encounter.scale_ti: 0 keeps the entity's own size. DMZ saga entities only.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.encounter.battle_p: 0 keeps the entity's own. What a scouter reads.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.encounter.ai_tier_: How the boss fights: Simple stays on the ground, Advanced dashes, teleports and reads you.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.encounter.transfor: The forms the boss changes into as it loses health.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.encounter.type_tip: Single Boss is one fight. Waves sends the enemy waves below, with the boss last. Boss Rush runs the stages below one after another. Waves and Boss Rush need Shurui's Key or Wolf's Key.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.encounter.countdow: Seconds between arriving in the arena and the fight starting.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.encounter.time_lim: Seconds before the run is failed. 0 is no limit.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.encounter.music_ti: Sound looped for the fighter in the rift, on the music channel. Starts on entry and loops until the boss dies or they leave. Searchable list of every sound; choose (none) for no music.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.encounter.spawn_on: When ON, the boss spawns seated on the chosen block inside the arena instead of the arena centre, so you can place that block to pick his exact spot. Nearest such block to the arena centre is used. If none is found, he spawns at the centre and a warning names the encounter.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.encounter.spawn_bl: Block the boss is seated on when the option above is ON. Default minecraft:obsidian.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.encounter.heal_on_: Fully heal the fighter as they step through.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.encounter.vanilla_: Let the boss drop its own loot as well as the rewards below.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.encounter.stages_n: Each stage is another boss, in order, with its own friendlies and side swap.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.encounter.waves_no: Used by the Waves fight type: what arrives, and in which wave.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.encounter.friendli: NPCs that fight on the player's side from the start.
They deal damage but do not pull the enemy off you, and killing them is not needed to win.
A stage can turn them against you: see Swap Sides on that stage.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.rift.encounter.rewards_: Handed to the fighter on a win. A tear has one fighter, so there is no top or runner up.

gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.cosmetics.subtitle: Cosmetic catalogue (%s)
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.cosmetics.tip_patr: Makes this a Patreon reward: every active patron at this tier or higher has it in their wardrobe on every server, and loses it when their pledge lapses. (none) for an ordinary cosmetic.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.cosmetics.tip_hide: For a HEAD piece that fully encloses the head (a pumpkin head, a full mask): hides the DragonMineZ hair so it does not poke through. Players can turn this off for themselves with /cosmetichair off.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.cosmetics.model_no: The model is the wardrobe icon already. Nothing is drawn on the player yet; the offsets below are saved for the renderer.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.cosmetics.tracker_: Counters only show on a Super copy. Tick Super above to let this cosmetic have one.
Defined and saved. Nothing increments a tracker yet.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.cosmetics.tip_name: The name players see in the wardrobe and the shop. The internal id was made from this and cannot be changed later.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.cosmetics.basics_n: A name, a slot and a model are all a cosmetic needs. The other tabs are optional.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.cosmetics.save_nee: Give it a name before saving.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.cosmetics.tip_even: Groups this cosmetic under an event, like Halloween. Pick an existing event or type a new one. Leave blank for none. A grouping label only, never a gate.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.cosmetics.tip_accs: How an accessory is drawn. Hand: a held prop shown only while a ki weapon is drawn. Float: a balloon that floats above on a string. Carried: held in the hand at all times. Only used on an accessory slot cosmetic.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.cosmetics.tip_moun: Whether this mount flies (jump climbs, sneak descends, holds altitude) or is ground based (gravity plus a hop). Only used on a mount slot cosmetic.
Drive speed in blocks per tick, before the sprint multiplier. Around 0.35 to 0.45 feels right. Only used on a mount slot cosmetic.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.cosmetics.tip_slot: Where this sits on the player. A cosmetic can only go in its own slot.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.cosmetics.tip_qual: Which qualities a copy of this may be. Normal is just the item, Super adds a counter, Magic adds a rolled effect. This is what a copy MAY be, not what any copy IS.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.cosmetics.tip_pool: Which effect pool a Magic roll on this item draws from when whatever is rolling does not name one. Blank means none. Nothing rolls yet.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.cosmetics.tip_enab: Off parks this without deleting it. Everyone who owns it keeps it.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.cosmetics.tip_trad: Ticking this lets the cosmetic be minted as an item, which can then be traded, auctioned for Zeni and mailed. A cosmetic bought with real money becomes convertible into the in game economy. Tick it only when that is intended.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.cosmetics.tip_copy: Copies the look, the qualities, the default pool and the trackers from another cosmetic. Never the id, the tradeable flag or the enabled flag.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.cosmetics.tip_mode: The item this cosmetic is drawn as, picked from our own cosmetic items. Only items we add to the cosmetic list appear here. It is also the wardrobe icon.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.cosmetics.tip_bone: Which body part this hangs off. Blank uses the slot's default.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.cosmetics.tip_trac: Renaming this resets the display choice of anyone who picked it.
The same conditions the task board counts against.
An entity, item, block or dimension id. Blank counts anything of that kind.
How the number reads, with %s where the count goes. For example: %s slain
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.cosmetic_crate.no_: No unbound crates. Create one below.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.cosmetic_crate.tip: The chance, 0 to 100, that a roll is upgraded to Super, for a cosmetic that allows it. Independent of Magic.
The chance, 0 to 100, that a roll is upgraded to Magic, for a cosmetic that allows it. When it is, an effect is drawn from the pool below.
Which pool a Magic roll draws an effect from. Blank falls back to each cosmetic's own default pool.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.crate_odds.title: Crate Odds
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.shop_listing.tip_t: What this listing sells: a cosmetic, a crate key, or a set (bundle). Fill only the fields for the type you pick.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.shop_listing.tip_q: How many keys one purchase hands over. Price the listing for the bundle, for example five keys at a discount.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.shop_listing.tip_s: The cosmetics in the bundle. Buying grants each one, subject to the re-grant setting below.
On, buying a set grants a fresh copy of every member (duplicates are tradeable). Off, it grants only the members the buyer is missing and refuses when they own them all.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.shop_listing.tip_d: The name shown on the shop tile for a key or set listing. Blank falls back to the key's name or a generic bundle name.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.shop_listing.tab_t: Per-player limit applies to cosmetic listings. Keys are unlimited; a set with re-grant off is limited by ownership.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.shop_listing.tip_c: Which cosmetic this offer sells. A shop purchase is always Normal quality and bound to the buyer.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.shop_listing.tip_p: The price in Shards. Zero is a free grant. Shards are bought with real money; nothing in game mints them.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.shop_listing.tip_l: How many one player may ever buy of this listing. 0 means unlimited.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.shop_listing.tip_w: The sale window, in epoch milliseconds. 0 means no bound. Leave both 0 for always on sale.

gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.chain_min_tip: Fewest orbs in a chain. A chain that cannot place at least this many is abandoned.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.chain_max_tip: Most orbs in a chain. Each chain rolls a length between min and max.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.spacing_tip: Blocks between one orb and the next along the chain.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.heading_drift: Most the chain may turn, in degrees, at each step (TRAIL and ARC only).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.interval_min_: Shortest wait, in seconds, between chains. The timer only counts down while an eligible player is in range.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.interval_max_: Longest wait, in seconds, between chains.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.max_chains_ti: Most live chains this one region may hold at once.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.time_of_day_t: When chains may spawn: ANY, only DAY, or only NIGHT. A dimension with no day cycle counts as ANY.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.min_dist_tip: Closest a chain may start to the anchoring player, in blocks (clamped to the region's placement radius).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.max_dist_tip: Farthest a chain may start from the anchoring player, in blocks.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.weight_tp_tip: Relative chance a chain pays Training Points. Weighed against the zeni weight.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.weight_zeni_t: Relative chance a chain pays zeni. Weighed against the TP weight.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.item_chance_t: Chance the last orb is an item orb, when the item pool is not empty. Otherwise the last orb pays the chain kind times the completion multiplier.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.completion_mu: Payout multiplier on the last orb of a chain.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.tp_min_tip: Least TP a TP orb pays, before multipliers.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.tp_max_tip: Most TP a TP orb pays, before multipliers.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.zeni_min_tip: Least zeni a zeni orb pays, before multipliers.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.zeni_max_tip: Most zeni a zeni orb pays, before multipliers.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.tp_falloff_ti: When on, TP orbs are additionally scaled by this region's level falloff (with a 20 percent floor).
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.share_party_t: When on, a TP orb's reward is shared with the claimant's party.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.strict_order_: When on, only the next orb in order is collectible and the rest are dimmed. When off, any orb except the item orb may be taken.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.claim_lock_ti: Seconds after each pickup during which only the claimant may continue the chain. Others see it grey.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.lifetime_tip: Seconds an untouched chain lives before it pops, paying nothing.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.progress_time: Seconds after the last pickup a claimed chain waits before the remaining orbs pop, paying nothing.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.transient_tip: Z orbs are never written to the world, so they leave no data behind. A chain in a chunk that unloads is lost with no reward.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.pool_item_tip: An item the last orb of a chain may hand out, chosen by weight at spawn so it can be shown inside the orb. Set a count range and a weight.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.g.chains_per_: Most live chains a single player may anchor at once.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.g.chains_serv: Most live chains across the whole server at once.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.g.chains_per_: Most chains one player may collect in an hour. 0 means unlimited.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.g.tp_per_day_: Most TP one player may earn from Z orbs in a day. 0 means unlimited.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.g.zeni_per_da: Most zeni one player may earn from Z orbs in a day. 0 means unlimited.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.g.item_orbs_p: Most item orbs one player may collect in a day. 0 means unlimited.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.g.afk_sec_tip: A player who has not moved at least 4 blocks within this many seconds does not anchor spawns.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.g.chain_separ: Least distance, in blocks, between the starts of two live chains.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.g.despawn_rad: A chain with no player within this radius, in blocks, for the timer below is removed.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.g.despawn_sec: Seconds with no player in range before a chain is removed.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.g.chime_sound: Sound played to the collector on each pickup (its pitch rises with the orb index). Blank is silent.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.g.completion_: Sound played when a chain is completed. Blank is silent.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.zorb.g.dim_add_tip: A dimension id (for example minecraft:the_nether) where Z orbs never spawn.
item.dmz_ragnarok.race_track_wand.tip1: Right-click to draw and edit a race track
item.dmz_ragnarok.race_track_wand.tip2: Left-click a node to select it; sneak to cycle mode

gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.race.tuning.roulet: How long the item-box roulette spins before the reveal.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.race.tuning.respaw: Ticks a picked-up item box stays hidden before it pops back.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.race.tuning.spirit: Seconds at the start of a race a Spirit Bomb may not be used.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.race.tuning.odds_t: Weights per finishing position: 1 = front runner, 8 = back marker. Higher weight = likelier item.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.race.tuning.use_gl: To drop this track's override and use the server default, run: /race track override %s clear
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.race.road.add_held: Adds the block held in your off-hand.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.race.road.count_ti: Racers keep full speed on these blocks. Any other block counts as off-road and slows them by the off-road multiplier.
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.race.editor.title: Track: %s
gui.dmz_ragnarok.core.race.editor.offroa: Speed multiplier off the surface set (0.05 - 1.0).
